claim: Soil analytical values are comparable only when property definition, sample support, preparation, extraction or digestion method, soil-to-solution ratio, reporting basis and unit are compatible or explicitly harmonized.
conditions: Especially important for pH in water versus KCl, available phosphorus by Olsen/Bray/Mehlich, potassium in mg/kg versus cmolc/kg, EC extract ratios, and SOC versus OM methods.
limitations: Conversions may be soil- and method-specific; a generic conversion can add bias.
recommended_action: Keep sample_actual simple, but maintain an indicator dictionary with canonical name, unit, method, extractant, ratio, detection limit, valid range and laboratory batch; split incompatible methods into separate targets.
not_allowed_action: Do not merge results from different methods into one target column merely because the element name is the same.
